videoArc.summary: Open on a macro of an unseen mass, pull back to show it dwarfs the markets everyone knows, then dive onto crypto and show it as loose change.

motifs.name: shadow mass
motifs.look: dark morphing blob, rainbow rim, trailing contour rings

videoArc.energyPlan: slow macro reveal, rising swells on each 'bigger', fast dive, soft comic landing

scenes.vo: There is a shadow market out there that is bigger than the stock market, bigger than the bond market, and makes the entire crypto market
scenes.claim: An unseen market is larger than the stock, bond and crypto markets.
scenes.metaphor: A vast dark morphing mass with a rainbow rim and trailing contour rings. The stock market is a small mint orb and the bond market a lavender squircle, born on its rim and pushed outward as it swells. Crypto is a tiny peach gem sitting inside it.
scenes.hero: The macro opening pulls back to reveal the mass, then it swells on each 'bigger' while the planets are pushed outward.
scenes.layout: Mass centered; orbs near left/right edges at about 1/5 and 4/5 of the width; gem low in the mass; one label at a time.
scenes.camera: Start at 2.3x macro on the rim; pull back to 1.0x by 3.2 s with a long ease-out; very slow settle to 0.85x by 8.5 s; subtle handheld drift.

beats.action: Label SHADOW MARKET builds letter by letter through a mask; underline draws on in rose
Mass inhales about 5% and sends a ripple ring outward
Mint orb is born on the left rim, springs outward with overshoot and a ripple; label STOCK MARKET builds in beneath it
Second, larger swell with ripple; orbs are nudged outward
Lavender shape is born on the right rim and breathes between circle and squircle; label BOND MARKET
Mass swells again and now spills past the frame
Tiny peach gem pops in low inside the mass with a ripple; label CRYPTO MARKET above it

scenes.handoff: Camera is about to dive onto the gem (world position slightly right of and below the mass centre); contour rings continue as background texture.
scenes.techNotes: Glows via gradients, not large blurs. Keep contour rings to 10.

scenes.vo: look like loose change found under a couch cushion
scenes.claim: Next to the shadow market, crypto is pocket change you'd lose in a sofa.
scenes.relationship: scale contrast, then a comic landing
scenes.metaphor: The camera dives onto the gem, which pops and bursts into pastel coins that spin and bounce across a dark contour landscape; a stitched pink cushion drops onto them, one coin sticking out.
scenes.hero: Dive, burst into coins, then the cushion drop with squash-and-stretch.
scenes.layout: Coins in a loose cluster at the centre; label near the top; cushion centered over the cluster.
scenes.camera: Fast ease-in-out dive from 0.85x to 3x between 8.5 s and 9.5 s with motion blur; hold with tiny drift.

beats.action: Gem swells, then bursts into 7 pastel coins with a ripple
Label LOOSE CHANGE builds in at the top; coins land with small bounces; sparkles glint in sequence
Label exits upward through its mask; cushion begins to fall from above
Cushion lands with squash-and-stretch and a rose ripple; one coin edge peeks out

scenes.techNotes: Camera dive needs motion blur or a short (<0.5 s) fast segment. Coin shadows via small blurred ovals.
